title: Zesty Uruguayan Beef Casserole
description: This Uruguayan-inspired casserole blends savory beef with matcha for a subtle earthy flavor. It’s creamy, nut-free, and ready in under an hour.

ingredients.name: beef chuck
ingredients.notes: cubed; use well-marbled cut for flavor

instructions: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add beef cubes and sear until browned on all sides.
In the same skillet, sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
Stir in matcha powder and soy sauce, cooking for one minute.
Return beef to skillet, pour in beef broth and tomato sauce, and add smoked paprika and oregano.
Bring to a simmer, then transfer the mixture to a casserole dish.
Spread mashed potatoes on top and sprinkle with salt.
Bake for forty-five minutes until potatoes are golden and beef is tender.
Let rest ten minutes before serving.
